_readme: Chart Forge colour tokens. To re-skin: edit here -> mirror into the :root and both dark blocks of assets/chartkit.css -> run scripts/validate_palette.py and ship only when light and dark both pass. The ORDER of the categorical slots is the colourblind-safety mechanism, not decoration.

categorical.order_rule: Take hues in order; colour follows the entity, never its rank. Scatter, bubble and any all-pairs use is capped at the first 3 slots; fold the rest into Other.

bloom.rule: Optional alternative set — the same slot ORDER discipline, more saturation. Adjacent slots are kept far apart in hue on purpose: the reference art can put orange next to amber because it is doing identity, not encoding; a chart cannot. Select with options.palette='bloom'. Ship only after scripts/validate_palette.py passes light AND dark.

sequential.rule: Magnitude: one hue, light to dark. The lightest step means near-zero and may recede into the surface.

ordinal.rule: Ordered categories (funnel stages, tiers): six steps of one hue; the lightest clears 2:1 against the surface.

diverging.rule: Signed values: blue <-> red with a neutral grey midpoint (light #efeee9 / dark #2c2d33) and equal steps per arm.

status.rule: A status colour always ships with an icon or a word, and is never reused as a series colour.

type.family: IBM Plex Sans, Noto Sans SC, PingFang SC, system-ui
type.numerals: tabular-nums for axis ticks, table columns and any vertically aligned figures; proportional figures for large standalone numbers.

shape.rule: The SECOND categorical channel. Shape follows the entity exactly as colour does, and the two are redundant — a chart stays readable in greyscale, in colourblind vision and on a badly calibrated projector. Shape encodes a CLASS and never a MAGNITUDE: a density or heat grid keeps ONE silhouette, because a second one sends the reader hunting for a grouping that is not there. Off below 14px (the silhouettes stop separating) and past 4 groups (they start interfering).

area_norm._why: Fraction-of-box areas differ wildly — a triangle fills about half of what a rounded square does. In a unit chart one mark is one unit, so without normalising, the triangle group silently reads as half its count. Multiply each glyph by its factor to equalise optical area.

geometry.rule: The element layer — these constants apply to EVERY form, including the ones whose marks never change shape (line, area, candle). THE AXIS RULE: volumetric cues and state motion always run PERPENDICULAR to the encoding axis. A vertical bar may shade across its width and breathe in scaleX; it must never shade or scale along its height, because the top edge is the value.
geometry._dose: Dose by aspect ratio: a 1:1 mark takes the full treatment (swell + gradient + specular + contact shadow), a 1:4 bar takes about a third of it and no specular. radius_bar at 0.5 makes a semicircle top and the bar reads as a finger — that is the ceiling, not the target.
